question.worked_solution:
The part is $14,$ the percentage is $20%,$ and we need to find the whole.

To do this, we can use the following formula:

$$
\text{whole}=\text{part}÷\text{percentage}
$$

Before we can substitute our numbers into the formula, we need to express $20%$ as a fraction:

$$
\frac{20}{100}=\frac{20÷20}{100÷20}=\frac{1}{5}
$$

We can now substitute our numbers into the formula, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{whole} & =14÷20% \\  & =14÷\frac{1}{5} \\  & =14\times \frac{5}{1} \\  & =14\times 5 \\  & =70\end{aligned}
$$
